verdict.line: You lose if you let Malphite's Granite Shield sit recharged and poke you down with Seismic Shard from range; you win if you stack Q to pull him in and chain W/E before his shield resets.

brief.thesis: Malphite's only early pressure is Seismic Shard (Q, 8s cooldown, 625 range) stealing your movement speed — he has no short-trade tool that beats your Q (3.5s cooldown) stacking into a shockwave pull. Once you hit 2 Ntofo Strikes stacks you can yank him into W (Path Maker)'s stun or E (Footwork)'s dash on your terms instead of his. The measured 49.3% win rate over 1142 games and K'Sante's solo-kill advantage both reflect this: it's close on paper, but the trade pattern is built for you, not him.

theirWindow.what: Don't open with your full combo into a recharged shield — it absorbs your opener for free. Poke it down with a Q or auto first, then commit.

yourWindow.when: You've landed 2 Q stacks on him
yourWindow.what: The shockwave pull yanks Malphite to you — immediately follow with W for the stun or E to reposition, since his shield is already cracked from the Q hits that built the stacks.

start.why: Highest win rate (49.6%) and by far the most picked start (79.9%) in this matchup — sustains you through the early Seismic Shard pokes while you wait for W to come online.

boots.why: Both his Q and E deal magic damage, and the tenacity shortens the airtime if he ever catches you with Unstoppable Force; measured as the stronger pick here (49.7% over Plated Steelcaps' 46.7%).

core.why: The cooldown and mana sustain feed your Q-stack trade pattern, and the proc adds extra zone damage exactly where you're already fighting.
Raw magic resist and a shield that mirrors his own Granite Shield, directly countering his all-magic Q/E damage.
Stacking resistances let you walk through his poke to force the all-in, which is where this matchup is won.

situational.when: the lane turns into a long stalemate and you need the omnivamp to win extended trades
their team adds a crit or attack-speed carry that needs an active slow
Malphite's magic poke is stacking with other AP damage on their team

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards exactly the short Q-stack-into-auto trade pattern this matchup is built on, converting every poke into free damage, healing, and max-health growth while his own damage output is low early.

summoners.why: Teleport is the dominant pick (86.1%) and lets you reset after trades or answer sidelanes once your Q/W stun-lock pattern takes over the lane; Flash covers the all-in engage and escape.

playing.title: Farm safely before level 3
playing.detail: Until W unlocks, respect Seismic Shard's 8s cooldown and 625 range — it steals your movement speed, so don't overextend chasing minions wide of your wave.

playing.title: Stack Q before you commit
playing.detail: Land Q on him repeatedly; at 2 Ntofo Strikes stacks the shockwave pulls him in, confirming your W stun or E dash instead of guessing on a cooldown you can't see.

playing.title: Poke the shield down first
playing.detail: Granite Shield absorbs your opener if it's recharged — land a Q or auto to crack it before going for the full W+E combo.

playing.title: Respect an active Brutal Strikes
playing.detail: When he activates W, his Armor and AD spike for a short window — don't trade into empowered autos, back off and let it expire.

playing.title: Pre-load attacks before Ground Slam
playing.detail: His E (7s cooldown) cuts your attack speed on hit, so land your Q and autos before it connects rather than relying on sustained attacks through it.

playing.title: Use All Out to isolate him
playing.detail: Once R is up, the initial knockback separates Malphite from his support before you go all-in with All Out's bonus damage and healing.

playing.title: Don't fear his ult 1v1
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force (130s cooldown at rank 1) is a map threat, not a lane-winning tool against you directly — keep trading, just track when it comes off cooldown for roams.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and all numbers above are measured from live ranked games on the current patch via OP.GG (1142 games, 49.3% win rate); the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own tactical read.
